answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a vertex tag. The raven cap is policed at intake and beacon shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a swarm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. Each copy needs 4 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
